dram_address_space.basis: The X100F 2.12 kernel MMU setup maps virtual 0-0x3fffffff as normal memory over physical 0 and 0x40000000-0x7fffffff as its uncached read-only alias; the setup is word-identical to the X-T20 2.11 one, whose table was read on hardware. The software-visible DRAM space therefore ends at 0x40000000; the installed capacity is not measured.
